minimal_implementable_contract.rule: Preserve Native's separate admitted model/binding on the new bound path. Other routes keep their existing adapters and admitted route; Cursor retains summarization_session_options (fixed summarization model, is_summarization_session=true, skip_labeling=true). Reuse summary's existing usage reporting, no-tools/reject-tool policy, no typed replay, no checkpoint resume, and cancellation reader. Simply replacing the closure with run_turn_memory_prompt would lose the current summary usage sink and Cursor session options. A private common implementation may share assembly while preserving each entry's admission semantics.

Cancellation stays with the current worker token and existing Inference/HTTP/Session/DB owners. Check it before bound-input refusal and preserve checks before/after credential construction, before/after both summary phases, after fitting and before guarded commit. Typed Cancelled is terminal even without token change; no subsequent prefix, fallback commit or reacquisition is permitted.

An Authentication/Configuration refusal must not retry with fresh credentials or another route. It remains an ordinary noncancelled summary failure for the existing compaction producer: a fitted local qualityDegraded fallback may commit under unchanged generation/tail/custody guards. Account-refusal oracles must assert no B inference request, not unconditionally no DB writes. Primary A success followed by B prefix refusal discards the partial candidate in favor of that existing fallback.

Keep the existing fresh run_summarization_prompt API for genuinely independent work: it resolves the current route/model and captures one fresh binding for that call. An invocation's name or missing binding does not make admitted history independent. MemorySynthesisService propose/verify are separate existing service consumers; preserve their API and cancellation behavior without claiming cross-phase continuity has been reviewed.
